items.name: Pink Rockstar Hair
items.description: Big hair, bigger chords. Practises between lectures.

items.name: Midnight Rockstar Hair
items.description: Dark and dramatic, for late-night riffs at the desk.

items.name: Golden Rockstar Hair
items.description: Shaggy and golden. Every exam is a stadium gig now.

items.name: Star Mic Sticker
items.description: A tiny star microphone for the cheek. Speaks up in class.

items.name: Mint Star Mic Sticker
items.description: Mint and fresh. Ready for the open mic at the library.

items.name: Berry Star Mic Sticker
items.description: Berry purple, with a mic that never runs out of ideas.

items.name: Gold Sequin Vest
items.description: Sparkles every time the buddy nods over a textbook.

items.name: Rose Sequin Vest
items.description: Rose sequins, for studying as if the spotlight is on.

items.name: Teal Sequin Vest
items.description: Cool teal sequins. Stage ready, notes ready.

items.name: Cream Earbud Necklace
items.description: Earbuds around the neck, between songs and chapters.

items.name: Mint Earbud Necklace
items.description: Always ready for the next playlist, after the next chapter.

items.name: Lilac Earbud Necklace
items.description: A lilac cord for focus music that actually helps.

items.name: Sunny Maracas
items.description: A shake for every finished page.

items.name: Mint Maracas
items.description: Shake them when the flashcards are right.

items.name: Berry Maracas
items.description: Shake for every streak. Rhythm helps memory, probably.

items.name: Gold Tambourine
items.description: Jingle when you finish a chapter. Small celebrations count.

items.name: Coral Tambourine
items.description: A coral tambourine that keeps the study rhythm.

items.name: Sky Tambourine
items.description: Light and bouncy, for study breaks with a beat.

items.name: Music Note Clip
items.description: A music note clip for the hair. Keeps the tune in place.

items.name: Mint Music Note Clip
items.description: Mint note with a purple sparkle. Hums along quietly.

items.name: Marching Drum Hat
items.description: A drum on the head, sticks crossed. Keeps a steady pace.

items.name: Slate Marching Drum Hat
items.description: Slate blue drum with a coral top. Steady, steady.

items.name: Glitter Liner
items.description: Glitter at the eye corners. Bright eyes, bright notes.

items.name: Mint Glitter Liner
items.description: Mint liner with gold glitter, for the review before the exam.

items.name: Lilac Gig Tee
items.description: A soft lilac tee with a star. Lectures are a gig too.

items.name: Ocean Gig Tee
items.description: Sky blue with a coral star. Tune up, then study.

items.name: Honey Ukulele
items.description: A little honey ukulele for a cheerful strum between sessions.

items.name: Mint Ukulele
items.description: Small and mint. Four strings, lots of study cheer.

items.name: Coral Stage Microphone
items.description: A coral mic for the stage. Read the summary out loud.

items.name: Sky Stage Microphone
items.description: A sky blue mic with a gold handle. You are heard.

items.name: Boombox Hat
items.description: A boombox on the head. The equaliser bounces to the beat.

items.name: Studded Jacket
items.description: Slate blue with silver studs and a zip pull that sways.

items.name: Sunset Guitar
items.description: A sunset-red guitar, gently swaying. Scales first, then songs.

items.name: Pink Label Record
items.description: A spinning record with a pink label. Play it on repeat.

items.name: Sky Tuning Fork
items.description: A tuning fork that hums. Perfect pitch for focus.

items.name: Sound Waves
items.description: Arcs of sound on both sides. The study playlist is loud.

items.name: Spotlight Hat
items.description: A stage spotlight on the head, glowing over the textbook.

items.name: Golden Trumpet
items.description: A trumpet that puffs out notes, for loud little successes.

items.name: Disco Ball
items.description: A spinning mirror ball that throws little sparkles around.

items.name: Floating Band
items.description: A tiny band floats around the buddy and plays for every finished deck.
